bdd_contract.nonclaim: Scenario-class labels are coverage requirements, not executable BDD evidence.

g1_exit_gate.claim: No command has a complete production semantic contract.

field_contracts.meaning: owned asset amounts indexed by owner and custody
field_contracts.name: balances
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: every claim is drained or assigned to an explicit reserve owner

field_contracts.meaning: external custody and claim buckets for managed assets
field_contracts.name: custody
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: no external effect exists without an ancestor custody claim

field_contracts.name: supply
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: issue, burn, and terminal supply disposition are explicit

field_contracts.name: debt
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: every liability has an exact close, redemption, or recovery owner

field_contracts.meaning: pool reserves, LP shares, fees, and rounding residues
field_contracts.name: lp_state
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: final LP removal drains reserves, fees, and dust exactly

field_contracts.meaning: margin, PnL, funding, insurance, and bad-debt liabilities
field_contracts.name: perps_liabilities
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: closed positions leave no unowned margin or liability

field_contracts.meaning: phase-bound deposits, bonds, inventory, and claims
field_contracts.name: escrows
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: cancel, expire, settle, or recover every escrow exactly once

field_contracts.meaning: fee, insurance, reward, and protected reserve buckets
field_contracts.name: reserves
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: each reserve has a named beneficiary and terminal disposition

field_contracts.meaning: auction phase, commitment, winner, and settlement records
field_contracts.name: auctions
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: all bids and inventory reach a deterministic final phase

field_contracts.meaning: requested, acknowledged, retried, and completed withdrawals
field_contracts.name: withdrawals
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: each withdrawal has one idempotent completion or refund

field_contracts.meaning: committed external effect identities and delivery state
field_contracts.name: outbox
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: every effect descends from one committed outbox ancestor

field_contracts.meaning: canonical command decisions, receipts, and publication lineage
field_contracts.name: history
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: replay and recovery classify one immutable publication identity

field_contracts.meaning: consumed sender nonces, proof identities, and replay keys
field_contracts.name: nullifiers
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: one nonce or nullifier authorizes at most one transition

field_contracts.meaning: deployment, authority epoch, profile, and release bindings
field_contracts.name: release_state
field_contracts.terminal_obligation: authority changes require an exact governed migration

EXCLUDE_UNTIL_CLOSED.meaning: Keep affected commands unreachable and without a production writer until the decision is closed.

EXPLICIT_NAMED_PROFILE.meaning: Select one exact policy with integer units, authority, bounds, effects, and terminal disposition.

VERSIONED_PROFILE_ALTERNATIVE.meaning: Select a versioned alternative with explicit activation, migration, compatibility, and rollback rules.

class_contracts.law: source debit equals destination credit in the same asset and event
issue authority and supply increase are bound in one accepted transition
burn authority, source custody, and supply decrease are bound in one accepted transition
the liability owner, asset, and before/after relation are explicit
ingress is authenticated and creates one custody claim before internal credit
outflow requires an ancestor custody claim and one committed outbox identity
refund target and source event are explicit and idempotent
slashing authority, beneficiary, and residue disposition are explicit
